relations.title: Context index permutation invariance
relations.transform: Permute Context Index entry order without changing entries.
relations.expected_relation: Compiled semantic pack membership, source digests, and protected ordering are unchanged.

relations.title: Request set permutation invariance
relations.transform: Permute set-valued request fields such as required IDs, characters, threads, and locations.
relations.expected_relation: Context selection remains semantically identical.

relations.title: Secret paraphrase remains tainted
relations.transform: Rewrite a secret-derived Writer artifact so no protected literal survives while keeping provenance unchanged.
relations.expected_relation: Semantic taint still blocks the artifact with the same secret identity.

relations.title: Irrelevant context expansion preserves protected core
relations.transform: Add a low-priority unrelated visible artifact under spare budget.
relations.expected_relation: Previously selected required/core artifacts remain selected with unchanged source identity; the follow-up may only add irrelevant material.

relations.title: Chapter availability boundary has directional effect
relations.transform: Move the target chapter from the last eligible chapter to the first expired chapter.
relations.expected_relation: The chapter-local artifact changes from included to expired, while unrelated entries remain stable.

relations.title: Declassification changes permission, not truth
relations.transform: Approve Writer declassification for one tainted artifact without changing its provenance or story facts.
relations.expected_relation: Only Writer visibility changes from blocked to admitted; taint/provenance identity remains intact.

relations.title: Event serialization invariance
relations.transform: Reorder JSON object keys and change JSONL whitespace without changing event values or order.
relations.expected_relation: Runtime validation and replay projection are unchanged.

relations.title: Dependency edge permutation invariance
relations.transform: Permute dependency edge serialization order.
relations.expected_relation: Reachable impact semantics are unchanged modulo presentation order.

relations.title: Disconnected dependency noise isolation
relations.transform: Add a disconnected dependency component unrelated to the queried node.
relations.expected_relation: Impact and Why-Trace semantics for the original component remain unchanged.

relations.title: Sibling branch perturbation isolation
relations.transform: Append a committed event only to one sibling branch after the fork.
relations.expected_relation: That branch changes; main and the other sibling replay identically.

relations.title: Stable entity label rename is local
relations.transform: Change a display label while keeping the stable entity ID and all other event semantics fixed.
relations.expected_relation: Replay changes only the display-label path; knowledge, custody, and entity identity remain unchanged.

relations.title: Prose rewrite invalidates evidence until refreshed
relations.transform: Rewrite the prose wording while preserving the reviewed durable delta, then refresh evidence hashes.
relations.expected_relation: Old evidence becomes stale; refreshed evidence validates; the reviewed state delta remains semantically identical.

relations.title: Project JSON representation invariance
relations.transform: Reserialize machine-readable project JSON with different key order and whitespace only.
relations.expected_relation: Kernel law statuses and semantic hashes remain unchanged.

relations.title: High-priority sibling-branch context noise is isolated
relations.transform: Add a much higher-priority Writer artifact scoped only to a sibling branch.
relations.expected_relation: The requested main-branch Writer Pack is unchanged.

relations.title: Secret registry permutation invariance
relations.transform: Permute active Secret Registry records without changing any record.
relations.expected_relation: Blocked secret identities and compiled pack semantics are unchanged.

relations.title: Local event contrast changes only its addressed semantic path
relations.transform: Change one valid event effect value while holding event structure and unrelated effects constant in an independent follow-up history.
relations.expected_relation: Replay differs exactly at the addressed path and preserves unrelated state.

relations.title: Actor-knowledge record permutation invariance
relations.transform: Permute independent knowledge records for the same actor without changing their contents or acquisition times.
relations.expected_relation: The actor knowledge set at a queried time remains equivalent modulo presentation order.

relations.title: Scene paraphrase with identical durable meaning
relations.transform: Paraphrase a scene without changing any reviewed durable fact.
relations.expected_relation: After evidence refresh, the durable delta set remains equivalent even though prose hashes differ.

relations.title: Chapter split or merge preserves world-event semantics
relations.transform: Split one chapter into two or merge two adjacent chapters without changing world events or exposure order.
relations.expected_relation: World-event semantics stay equivalent; discourse coordinates change in a controlled, explicit way.

relations.title: Global display-name substitution preserves stable semantic graph
relations.transform: Replace character display names everywhere while preserving stable IDs and relationships.
relations.expected_relation: ID-addressed world, epistemic, reader, and dependency graphs remain isomorphic.

relations.title: Revelation channel substitution preserves exposure meaning
relations.transform: Move the same discoverable fact from dialogue into observable action or physical evidence without changing what an attentive reader can infer.
relations.expected_relation: Reader exposure content remains equivalent while discourse channel metadata changes.

relations.title: Inactive optional capability does not become universal readiness debt
relations.transform: Add a valid Project Manifest optional_artifacts record with status=inactive for a capability whose file is absent.
relations.expected_relation: Project Doctor remains successful; inactive capability declaration may warn but must not become a missing-required error.

relations.title: Scoped Project Poetics override is local and inherits without parent mutation
relations.transform: Register one valid chapter-scoped Project Poetics override and its active provenance envelope while leaving the canonical parent unchanged.
relations.expected_relation: The override appears in the target chapter context, the parent hash is unchanged, the next chapter without the override compiles identically to baseline, and direct out-of-scope reuse is rejected.

relations.title: Authorized heterogeneity changes classification, not measured drift
relations.transform: Keep the dialogue corpus fixed, then add a valid scoped Project Poetics authorization for the measured character-voice shift.
relations.expected_relation: The drift indicator and feature measurements stay identical; the same shift changes from review to authorized-variation only when provenance-backed authorization is supplied.

relations.title: Poetics-preserving surface variation leaves poetics projection invariant
relations.transform: Change only task-surface character and setting names while keeping the same scoped Project Poetics artifact, envelope, scope, and active capability declaration.
relations.expected_relation: The task pack changes non-vacuously, but scoped-poetics provenance, authority/scope/hash identity, and active capability projection remain unchanged.

relations.title: Hard Core is invariant across conflicting valid Project Poetics
relations.transform: Hold world/runtime/knowledge/evidence state fixed while replacing the Project Poetics artifact with a deliberately conflicting valid literary contract; repeat after injecting the same hard semantic fault into both variants.
relations.expected_relation: Narrative Semantics Kernel verdicts are identical across poetics, and the same injected hard fault remains a hard failure under both rather than being masked or relaxed by literary preferences.

relations.title: Witness-sensitive social context
relations.transform: Change the witness from colleague to patron, preserving the public statement.
relations.expected_relation: Writer pack changes only the authorized scoped commitment; invariant fact bytes remain unchanged; inactive capability references remain excluded. This does not prove generated literary effects.

relations.title: Narrating age and factual memory
relations.transform: Change narrating age and interpretation, preserving the loan fact.
relations.expected_relation: Writer pack changes only the authorized scoped commitment; invariant fact bytes remain unchanged; inactive capability references remain excluded. This does not prove generated literary effects.

relations.title: Material object and changed relation
relations.transform: Change admiration to shame, preserving the dented plate fact.
relations.expected_relation: Writer pack changes only the authorized scoped commitment; invariant fact bytes remain unchanged; inactive capability references remain excluded. This does not prove generated literary effects.
